entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I received last week. I'd like to return a helmet.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your order number?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Trailblazer MIPS Helmet. To make sure I'm getting you the right solution, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?
It's just a preference. The color in person is a bit different than it looked on my screen. It’s a great helmet, just not the right shade for my bike.
I understand completely, getting the color right is important. Is the item still in new condition?
Yes, absolutely. The box is unopened. I saw the color through the plastic window and knew it wasn't going to work, so I haven't even taken it out.
Perfect. I see here that your order was delivered 9 days ago, which places you well within our 90-day return policy. I can approve this return for a full refund immediately.
That's great news. Now, since I'll be ordering another one right away and I'm saving you the trouble of dealing with a used item, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase?

I appreciate you asking and for keeping the product in perfect condition for us. While our system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for returns, I can assure you that the full refund will be processed promptly once the item is received. And of course, your next helmet will come with the same high-level safety guarantee as all VeloFit products.
Alright, that's fair. A refund is what I called for, so I'm happy with that. What do I do next?

I have just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Simply print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse processes it, you'll see the refund in 3-5 business days. Can I assist you with anything else?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
